### Installing on Windows

This installer is not code-signed, so Microsoft Defender SmartScreen warns before it runs.

1. Download `Paseo-Setup-<version>-x64.exe`, or the `arm64` installer for Windows on Arm.
2. If your browser says the file isn't commonly downloaded, keep it. In Edge, click **…** → **Keep** → **Show more** → **Keep anyway**.
3. Run the installer. When **Windows protected your PC** appears, click **More info**, then **Run anyway**.

Each new version starts with no SmartScreen reputation, so you see the warning again when you download a new installer.

If there is no **Run anyway** button, Smart App Control or your organization's policy blocks unsigned apps on that PC, and this build can't be installed there.
